Relative path href renders as inline link (#397)

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"/docs/intro.html\">/docs/intro.html</a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
